notes: This is the 1880 Federal Census Mortality Schedule (Schedule 2) for Savoy/Fannin County, listing persons who died in the year ending May 31, 1880. This would include victims of the great cyclone of May 29, 1880. The document is heavily degraded with many names and values illegible. Enumerator is F. M. Murray (same as the regular census). Causes of death where visible include Consumption and what may be Lockjaw. Many rows are almost entirely illegible. The Remarks section at the bottom is signed by F. M. Murray but the text is largely illegible. This is a critical document for identifying tornado victims.
